svg.title: Memory for LLM agents, 2023 to 2026
svg.desc: A timeline of papers from 2023 to 2026 in four rows. Systems: Generative Agents (April 2023), MemoryBank (May 2023), MemGPT (October 2023), Zep (January 2025), A-MEM (February 2025), Mem0 (April 2025), MemOS and MIRIX (July 2025), LightMem (October 2025). Learned write policies: Memory-R1 (August 2025) and Mem-α (September 2025). Benchmarks: LoCoMo (February 2024), LongMemEval (October 2024), MemoryAgentBench (July 2025), HaluMem (November 2025), EvoMemBench (May 2026), ForgetEval (June 2026). Surveys: CoALA (September 2023), Rethinking Memory (May 2025), Memory in the Age of AI Agents (December 2025), Memory for Autonomous LLM Agents (March 2026). The systems cluster in 2023 and 2025; the independent benchmarks that re-run them cluster in late 2025 and 2026.
